item.title: Bond County Final Multiplier Set At 1.0000 | News#
item.description: The State of Illinois has set Bond County’s final property assessment equalization factor, or multiplier, at 1.0000 for 2025 taxes payable in 2026. item.title: KC Board Approves Personnel Changes | News#
item.description: The Kaskaskia College Board of Trustees approved several personnel changes during its March meeting. Appointments include a new Assistant Professor of Dental Assisting and a new Assistant Professor of Respiratory Therapy. The board also accepted the resignation of the Director of TRiO and approved a retirement effective in early April.
